n = int(input())
capacity = int(input())

data = [0] * (n + 1)
evenSum = [0] * (n + 1)
oddSum = [0] * (n + 1)

for i in range(1, n + 1):
    data[i] = int(input())
    if data[i] % 2 == 0:
        evenSum[i] = evenSum[i - 1] + 1
        oddSum[i] = oddSum[i - 1]
    else:
        oddSum[i] = oddSum[i - 1] + 1
        evenSum[i] = evenSum[i - 1]

segmentDiffs = []

for j in range(2, n):
    diff = abs(data[j] - data[j + 1])
    if evenSum[j] == oddSum[j]:
        segmentDiffs.append(diff)

segmentDiffs.sort()

countSegments = 0
for diff in segmentDiffs:
    if capacity >= diff:
        capacity -= diff
        countSegments += 1
    else:
        break

print(countSegments)
